description: Turn this on at the START of anything with several steps — a sign-up, a wizard, creating an app in a developer console, a checkout. From then on every click, key, fill, type, upload and navigation on that tab answers with the STEP IT LED TO: the page is waited for until it stops loading, and the reply carries `step` — where the wizard is (`progress`), what changed since the last step (`changes`: a button became active, an error appeared, a new heading), the fields still to fill, the live buttons, and `yourMove`. No qa_snapshot, qa_read or qa_wait_ready between steps: the reply to the press IS the next step, so keep going instead of stopping to report after each one. WHEN THE STEP IS THE PERSON'S — a password, a code from their phone or mail, a captcha — the step says `personNeeded`. Tell them in one line, then call `qa_follow { waitForPerson: "<that line, in their language>" }` in the same turn: the line is shown beside the field and as a «Your turn» card at the top of the page that survives reloads (extension 1.87+), and the call returns by itself the moment the page moves on (up to 15 minutes; `stillWaiting` means call it again — never ask them to write that they are done). It stays on until qa_done or `off: true`; a new qa_follow with another goal replaces it. Reading only: following needs no consent, the acting verbs keep their own gate.

goal.description: The whole task in one line, e.g. "create a Meta app for Shelf and copy its App ID". It rides every step so the end of the task stays in view.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

timeoutMs.description: With waitForPerson: how long to wait, default 300000, max 900000

waitForPerson.description: Wait until the PERSON finishes their step and the page moves on. A string is shown to them on the page next to the field — write it in their language; `true` waits without showing anything (use it when calling again after stillWaiting).

name: qa_follow
title: Follow a multi-step task
